討論金融資料與 AI 研發

產業問題與工程挑戰

投資研究需要跨文件整理事實、公司關係與時間先後。摘要若和來源脫節，後續很難查證。 研究內容會隨新資料變動，資料層需保留文件上下文、版本及關係的來源，才能區分觀察、推論與歷史資料。

技術方法與架構

實作與交付

創辦人參與研發工作。公開案例限於可追溯的資料工程及研究工作區。相關公開論文另載其研究方法。

成果

研究工作區支援回看版本與引用，並連結至公司關係的原始文本。

  • 附來源內文的公司與供應鏈關係資料

驗證與證據

以抽查引用、關係來源和版本順序作為可重現的審查方式。公開範圍為研究工作流。

Selected Work

AI Investment Research Platform

Founder Engineering Experience · Engineering Development

Organize investment research in a conversational workspace with traceable company relationships and source-linked findings.

繁體中文

Industry problem and engineering challenge

Investment research requires piecing together facts, company relationships and event order across documents. Summaries become difficult to check when separated from their sources. As new information changes the research, the data layer must preserve document context, versions and provenance so users can distinguish observations, interpretations and historical material.

Technical approach and architecture

Implementation and deliverables

The founder contributed to development. The public case covers traceable data engineering and the research workspace. A separate publication documents the associated research method.

Outcome

The research workspace supports version and citation review, including links to the original text for company relationships.

  • Investment research workspace
  • Multilingual research notes
  • Source-backed company and supply-chain relationships

Validation and evidence

Audit citation accuracy, the source text for relationships and version order as reviewable checks. Public disclosure is limited to the research workflow.

  • Financial intelligence services and research scope
  • Public research · An empirical study of automated market-maker rebalancing
